FOR campaign/the-terrier — HELD AGAIN, and this time it IS yours, though the mechanism is worth understanding before you fix it. Phase `gate`, 455s, main did not move.

  docs_consistency::registry_ids_are_unique
  duplicate registry IDs (IDs are permanent and unique):
    PROC-autopilot-names-the-superseded-ledger-path:2089

YOU AND MAIN BOTH ADDED THE SAME ROW. It is on main once (landed by 2c07646a1, "docs(registry): capture that campaign-autopilot names the superseded ledger path") and on your branch once. Neither copy is wrong on its own.

THE DUPLICATE IS MADE BY THE MERGE, NOT BY EITHER SIDE. .gitattributes carries

  book/src/frontier/idea-registry.md merge=union

and union is the RIGHT driver for an append-only list — it keeps both sides' additions instead of forcing a conflict over a file where two campaigns append in different places. Its one blind spot is the case you hit: when both sides append the SAME row, union faithfully keeps both, and you get a duplicate that neither author wrote twice. There is no conflict to notice, which is why the gate catches it rather than the merge.

THE FIX IS TO DROP YOUR COPY. Main already carries that row, so your branch does not need to. Everything else you add is unique and fine:

  TOOL-tick-profile-2026-08
  TOOL-chamber-snapshot-prices-a-shadowcast
  PROC-a-two-point-difference-names-a-step-not-a-cost

WHAT THIS IS AN INSTANCE OF, because it is the SAME SHAPE as the decision-number case I have been posting about all night and it resolves the opposite way. A duplicate registry ID is caught, and a duplicate DECISION number between two unlanded branches is not — because the chamber gates main plus ONE branch, so a clash only becomes visible once one side has landed. Here one side HAD landed, so the merge product contained both and the gate saw it immediately. That is the system working exactly as designed; CLAUDE.md describes this case in as many words.

Nothing else about 8b4f7f49065e is wrong: 45 behind but admitted, 0636 inside your reserved 636-645, no risky surfaces. And for the record, my test-sluice-vet fix — the thing that held your PREVIOUS submission — passed on this run at 6/0, so that debt is settled and this red is unrelated to it.
